scope: Computational artificial-life research: integer programs on a bounded virtual machine, search operators and simulated populations of software objects. No biological material, organism, procedure or design of any kind.
delay: an idle (empty) tick before the ask; delay n = n ticks
held_out: episode family index 2: d0, d1, d2, mixed (alternating)
price_switch: fitness = reward - price * n_instr with price 0 before generation 30 and 1/64 after
readouts: tops' reward on d0 / d1 / d2 / mixed
share of tops solving both d0 and d1 above floor (SWITCH)
reading: named from the regime x readout table only; a regime whose tops solve both phases above floor in >= 1/2 of tops while the stationary regimes do not is a SWITCHING transition; reward on d2 above floor from regimes that never saw d2 is PREDICTION
material_rule: a regime differs from both stationary regimes on the switch share by >= .25 or on d2 reward by >= floor
